meta.title: Code.org's CS Discoveries (Units 1-2)
meta.caveat: Locators here are studio.code.org's own URL position numbers (1-4), not the 'Unit Nb' display labels -- position 3 displays as 'Unit 3a' and position 4 as 'Unit 3b' (code.org does not split Interactive Animations and Games into two separate units the way an earlier draft of this carrier assumed; 3a is a wholly different unit, Programming with Music Lab). This is one of three sibling carriers split out of a single combined 'codeorg_csd' file so each can be toggled independently on the coverage map, matching how this teacher actually runs the course -- Units 1-2 are usually taught together, 3a and 3b are each optional and often skipped depending on the semester, with 3b (the game-building unit) the one most reliably taught and the one students engage with most. All csta2017 citations were fetched directly from each unit's own live standards page (studio.code.org/courses/csd-2026/units/N/standards, which embeds a per-lesson JSON rollup in a data-unit-rollup attribute) on 2026-08-29 -- current, official, and machine-read. csta2026 and ca-ict-anchor entries are this carrier's own topic-level inference from lesson names/objectives, not a code.org claim -- code.org's own citations are all CSTA 2017 (the 2026 CSTA revision isn't reflected in code.org's own standards data yet), kept deliberately sparse.
